application_checkout_policy: Read only, after git pull --no-rebase. No product commit or push; any product fix and failing-first test must be exported to ~/codex-runs/r13-patches/.
sources: IEEE754 nearest/even arithmetic and annuity algebra
Existing R10 Excel readings reproduced in R12; all are discovery evidence
Existing cleared research interpreter and independent rational checker
motivation: Earlier PC64 chains and PC53 consumer extensions do not exhaust internal elementary-chain stores or PC53 chain arithmetic. Run native ISA instructions, never substitute a correctly rounded mathematical library for microcode.

arithmetic.precision: PC53 or PC64 arithmetic consumes full 80-bit operands. Preparation/log-exponent arithmetic, pow2 reconstruction, consumer body, and final consumer arithmetic each choose a fixed word independently (16 combinations, including both uniform settings). Kahan correction returns to the preparation word. A resident PC64 quotient can feed a PC53 final product. Precision control does not reduce FYL2X/FYL2XP1/F2XM1 outputs. Execute those instructions with the declared word.
arithmetic.stores: Enumerate resident or FSTP binary64/reload after every nontrivial helper/consumer operation, except integer reduction, exact sign changes, ROM/input loads and the mandatory final publication. Tbyte instrumentation preserves all ten bytes and is not a binary64 program store.
arithmetic.hardware_scope: Native AMD CPU identified in environment.json; no cross-CPU microcode equivalence claim. Windows questions retain CPU/build/transport provenance.

log_paths: FYL2X(ln2,1+r) then multiply n and log2(e)
FYL2XP1(ln2,r) then multiply n and log2(e)
FYL2XP1(n,r) with period multiplication inside the instruction
reconstruction: positive reconstruction then reciprocal for a negative exponent
Kahan difference correction (u-1)*x/log2(u) in all three associations
Kahan difference correction (u-1)*(x*ln2)/ln(u) in all three associations
grammar.correction_scope: Finite nonunit u and nonzero logarithm. The independent checker verifies these conditions on every sufficient counterexample used; no fitted branch, cutoff or selected value is introduced.
grammar.consumers: Growth and discount annuity identities, two numerator associations, all60 ordered four-factor multiplication/division trees with degrees (N:+1,r:+1,em:-1,tf:-1), and8 fixed subtractive/complement/distributed-denominator/discount-rate identities. The last arithmetic instruction independently chooses PC53 or PC64. Timing uses the original rate and canonical timing. All constants are 0, 1, FLDLN2 and FLDL2E.
grammar.enumeration: Program IDs are template ID, phase control words and complete store mask. The exact generated template list and all masks define the bounded family. Counts include declared dead/redundant site choices, never additional product gains. The initial23,592,960, expanded448,266,240, phase896,532,480 and five-path25,700,597,760 assignments are prior subsets, not counts to add. Their sources, receipts and packet snapshot remain archived.

certificate: Every excluded helper/consumer assignment has a first counterexample. Helper values are shared only on exact ten-byte equality for that witness. Independent rational replay checks ordinary arithmetic, stores, reductions and publication; native instruction replay checks each microcode leaf. Coverage checker reconstructs the entire Cartesian family and rejects duplicates, omissions and changed source/evidence.
limits: Exclusion is limited to this finite instruction grammar on recorded effective-input assumptions. No surviving row-specific value is a fitted helper or complete function. The 409 annuity corpus mismatches and 24 PMT gaps remain open without a complete identified kernel.
